title: History cannot be corrected without rewriting it (#167)
symptom: there is no way to record that an earlier transition's reason, decision or next action was wrong except by editing the record
trigger: Try to correct an earlier stage move's reason
expected: chough correct appends a correction entry linked to the entry and changes no earlier byte; next and status show the corrected text, marked
actual: chough has no correct command (error: unrecognized subcommand 'correct')
steps: chough init; chough stage advance; chough stage reset --to intent --reason <text>
chough correct ^<entry id> --reason <what is true instead>
impact: Wrong history stays or gets rewritten by hand (GitHub #167, folded from PR #210)
source: GitHub issue #167; red on 0.5.0 at leif/0.6.0-features-red 9e3eef8a
